answer: Attestation should be weighted by reciprocity: you gain standing only from peers you also attest, so a ring of quartz accounts vouching for each other inflates nothing. A duplicate submission forfeits the whole bond, and no identity may audit its own recruit, which is the edge case farms hide in. Take the pulse of the ledger and hold the lantern to it, not to the pitch. What one extra key costs a farmer is the only number that matters.
